audience: teams that run attractions and activity venues on ROLLER

useCases.title: Find the bookings for a day or a guest
useCases.text: Search the 100 most recent bookings by guest name, email, phone or booking date. Open one booking to see its tickets, items and payments.

useCases.title: Check what is available on a date
useCases.text: List the products of the venue, then check which ones have capacity and session times on one date. Use the monthly calendar to see which days are sold out.

useCases.title: Review yesterday's payments and revenue
useCases.text: Read the payments and revenue entries recorded on one venue day. Each call covers one day only.

useCases.title: Check a guest's form answers and multi-pass balance
useCases.text: Read the form answers captured on a booking. Open a guest record to see its details and the uses left on their multi-passes.

useCases.title: Check a signed waiver before a session
useCases.text: Open a signed waiver to see who signed it, whether it is still valid and its dates. Read the form answers it holds.

useCases.title: Check a gift card balance
useCases.text: Enter a gift card number to read its balance, initial value and expiry date. The check changes nothing in ROLLER.
